# Code Grading Suite

> Rubric and prompts for AI coding agents to grade a codebase from 1 to 10 on 35 benchmarks and improve it against those grades. Version 3.1.0. Agents: start with AGENT.md.

## Start
- [AGENT.md](AGENT.md): entry point for agents (roles, how to download and verify the suite)
- [Overview](suite/README.md): the grade, improve and review workflow

## Prompts
- [Grader](suite/prompts/grader.md): full audit prompt
- [Improver](suite/prompts/improver.md): improve code against a report
- [PR quick mode](suite/prompts/pr-review.md): grade a single change

## Rubric
- [A · Correctness & Trust](suite/rubric/A-correctness-trust.md)
- [B · Design & Structure](suite/rubric/B-design-structure.md)
- [C · Code Health](suite/rubric/C-code-health.md)
- [D · Value & Fitness](suite/rubric/D-value-fitness.md)
- [E · Adoption & Experience](suite/rubric/E-adoption-experience.md)
- [F · Operations & Delivery](suite/rubric/F-operations-delivery.md)
- [X · Conditional](suite/rubric/X-conditional.md)
- [Weights, targets & maturity](suite/rubric/weights.md)
- [weights.json](suite/rubric/weights.json): canonical weights, targets and maturity rules

## Tools
- [gradekit.py](suite/tools/gradekit.py): validate, verify-evidence, rollup, stability, diff, calibrate, redact, rollup-repo
- [report.schema.json](suite/schema/report.schema.json)
- [Download the kit](downloads/code-grading-suite-3.1.0.zip)
- [manifest.json](manifest.json): checksums
